text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Potable water consumption in Kuwait is the world's highest, minister says.
- Parliament wants a solution to the unemployment problem within six months, deputies say.
- Al-Ahli Bank says net profit rise to 6.3 million dinars in 1996.
- No political reasons for my resignation, Health Minister Anwar al-Nouri says.
- Cabinet to discuss the resignation of Health Minister Anwar al-Nouri after the Eid al-Fitr holiday.
